metadata.title: Task-specific domain leader evidence and falsifiable benchmark
metadata.consumer: G-2787 initial broad journey researcher; supporting evidence only, not the final roadmap
metadata.research_status: First complete research benchmark; implementation and comparative task criteria are not run

conclusion.completeness: No present superiority or complete parity claim is supported. VNDB/Bangumi native specialist semantics, mature community maintenance, personal fidelity and domain-specific runtime tasks all require receipts. Unsupported leader strengths remain explicit.
conclusion.strongest_engine_candidate: One contextual identity/evidence/history/query engine can connect exact releases, qualified associations, personal history and spoiler-aware wikis. Current source makes this plausible, not demonstrated.
conclusion.decision: Prioritize the finite six-item evidence batch below for synthesis, reusing current audit repairs and frozen corpora. Do not expand product scope merely to make this report look comprehensive.

evidence_kinds.direct_text_observation: Public product text or schema inspected in this session; establishes only content present in that response, not visual behavior or successful interaction.
evidence_kinds.documented_behavior: Primary operator/project/standards documentation; a published claim or contract, not independently verified user effectiveness.
evidence_kinds.retained_observation: Prior report reused with its original date/revision and access limits; no fresh browser or screenshot claim.
evidence_kinds.local_contract_intent: Authoritative local product/contract requirement; never proof of implementation.
evidence_kinds.local_source_inference: Read current local source at the recorded Git revision; explains representation or candidate gaps, not executing behavior.
evidence_kinds.untested_hypothesis: Candidate improvement or comparative advantage requiring the proposed tests; all candidate_improvements and next-batch ranking are in this category.

performed: Read this Goal, product positioning, scope, relevant contracts, audit coverage/decisions and retained source evidence before extending research.
Read current official public help/product text/API schemas/source without account actions.
Read-only public retrieval of pinned Bangumi OpenAPI source; local file/source inspection.
Constructed a benchmark and performed report-only structural/reference/coverage validation.
Reviewed authoritative manager documentation changed by the worker-check rebase and recorded the update separately without replacing historical source evidence.
not_performed: No user testing, interviews, timed comparison or statistical effectiveness study.
No browser exploration, rendered screenshot inspection, external login, purchase, contribution, account write, credentials, game/application package download/install or live REZICS service.
No product code edits, product test suites, external repository uploads or nested agents.
methodology.source_policy: Use primary evidence and exact URLs. Rolling pages have access dates rather than invented release versions. Indexed-only/blocked/current-private API material is labeled and cannot prove live workflow success. No secondary article is used as product truth.
interpretation_rules: No provider response, dataset slice, field list, count, 200 status or registered route substitutes for a complete native job.
Do not subtract counts across dates, caches, catalogue grains or disclosure contexts. Keep API coverage, website behavior and source-only data separate.
An explicit rollout deferral is an honest unsupported capability in a full leader comparison; it cannot be scored as an achieved parity win.
All job pass/fail criteria are proposed acceptance requirements, not assertions that current REZICS passed or failed on this revision. Historical audit failures are separately dated.

scope.requested_depth: Full named-job benchmark for VNDB/Bangumi, Steam and games beyond Steam, Reddit/Fandom and community beyond them, plus professional Book/Recipe tasks.

supported_inventory.music_and_other_media: MEDIA-01 initial grain benchmark; film/TV/serial episode specialist workflows not fully qualified
supported_inventory.skills_prompts_mcp: AI-01 initial artifact/trust benchmark; model hosting is adjacent evidence, not an assumed supported product

scope_limits: Music, software/mod and AI entries expose concrete leaders and one finite difficult task each; they do not claim the same research depth as the named primary domains.

Film/TV diary/episode, institutional/collector/study, commercial distribution and full wiki-host migration retain unqualified specialist work. This is a residual qualification debt, not deletion from ambition.
No endless campaign or one-page-universal solution is prescribed. Later vertical work requires a bounded task and evidence, coordinated by G-2787.
scope.launch_policy: The read local policy closes distribution/commerce and many later rollouts; the maintainer’s current ambition forbids describing that launch cut as full leader completeness.

evidence_registry.title: VNDB Kana API
evidence_registry.publisher_role: Product operator, project maintainer, or standards body
evidence_registry.version: Kana API v2; rolling reference
evidence_registry.access_method: Public official text fetched through web research
facts: Kana API v2 exposes VN, release, character, staff, tag, trait and user-list reads, with explicit fields, nested filters and bounded pagination.
Release-contained filters and character appearances retain context; main and primary roles differ. Edition IDs are VN-local and unstable across edits. Partial dates are not ordinary full dates.
Character traits carry spoiler and lie information; list access has read/write scopes and private labels. The API intentionally omits website forums and database editing.

Before disclosure, protected names, counts, snippets, image descriptions, suggestions, inverse links and evidence/export identifiers are absent or an authorized unavailable form; after disclosure only the permitted evidence appears.
Users can distinguish an accepted claim, a spoiler-level annotation, a contradicted/lie claim and source uncertainty without treating one vote score as truth.

candidate_improvements: Make same-participant and disclosure obligations shared read contracts; qualify a contradiction and multi-appearance fixture before presenting character superiority.

job_benchmarks.task: Maintain playing/finished/stalled/dropped/wishlist states, private labels, progress, ratings and reviews independently.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: VNDB list labels/progress and Bangumi collection/episode/volume states coexist with scores, comments and reviews.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: A private list returning nothing to another viewer is not proof of no entries. Bangumi explicitly warns updated_at is unreliable; importing it as a completion or acquisition date fabricates history.

rezics.fit: Library/status/rating/import/export components and copy/loan separation exist.
rezics.gap: Current end-to-end mapping of provider labels, unknown timestamps, rereads and review targets needs an exact-field roundtrip witness.

pass_fail.criterion: S-LIBRARY transitions retain separate list status, chapter/episode/volume or game progress, rating, review, note, privacy and session. Changing one alters no unrelated field.
Import, export, reimport and duplicate replay preserve every supported personal field; unsupported fields receive a loss entry and uncertain dates stay unknown.
Private labels/reviews never leak to public search, feeds, statistics or another Person’s export; public and private counts follow the explicitly selected visibility contract.

candidate_improvements: Publish an explicit provider-list mapping and loss report; expose a session/history view instead of overwriting one completion timestamp.

job_benchmarks.task: Build, share, reopen and revise a precise tag/trait/release/role query without changing its semantics.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: VNDB supports nested filters and reverse tag/character discovery; retained AO3 evidence adds canonical tag wrangling and include/exclude composition. Bangumi documents AND semantics and experimental search.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: A year-only date equality in Kana is not the same as a full-year date range. Canonical/synonym expansion, any/all and excluded spoilers must not be implied by one flat tag field.

rezics.fit: Search/discovery and release-filter owners provide the engine; saved views remain an explicit rollout/qualification issue.
rezics.gap: Multiword/CJK recovery, retained scope, bounded suggestions, qualified filtering and truthful continuation need receipts; no proposed query UI establishes them.

pass_fail.criterion: A shared URL or serialized query reopens the same included/excluded terms, any/all groups, exact release/role scope, locale and Context. Unsupported operators receive an explicit refusal.
Unquoted nonadjacent multiword and CJK single-character cases follow the local search decision; quoted phrases remain explicit, and zero-result recovery preserves all other scope.
All authorized pages exhaust without duplicate or missing results, invalid/expired cursors offer recovery, and hidden labels never enter suggestions or counts.

candidate_improvements: Use one typed query representation and render its active scope; qualify synonym/hierarchy semantics per domain before claiming canonical tag parity.

job_benchmarks.task: Correct a field or credit with attribution, review its history, withdraw one support and export a faithful cut.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: Bangumi public revisions and VNDB editing/history plus daily near-complete dumps make attribution and portability real comparator jobs.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: Kana omits editing but VNDB does not. Its dump omits change histories/private lists and has an unstable schema; image rights are separate. Two independent supports are not one mutable source row.

rezics.fit: Exact observations, independent supports, history and correction/withdrawal decisions have native owners.
rezics.gap: Source attribution must be navigable and actionable in the populated product; API export breadth, license handling and contributor operations are not proved by source retention alone.

pass_fail.criterion: A proposal records exact target/meaning/context, original actor, source revision/pointer, reason and rights disposition; a stale edit is refused with a recoverable base and retry creates one logical change.
Correction/withdrawal changes only the authorized contribution/support; surviving independent evidence remains, historical attribution is immutable, and moderation does not grant author authority.

Export enumerates all elected native and source-only fields with source revision, coverage and losses; withheld payloads/IDs do not leak. Advertised dump/media support is backed by an actual authorized export, otherwise labeled unsupported.

candidate_improvements: Expose contribution history and source dispositions from the same ownership model; qualify exact correction/withdrawal plus export before expanding import volume.

job_benchmarks.persona: Player deciding what to play next
job_benchmarks.task: Discover a suitable game through search, genre/feature filters, trusted curation and usable-release evidence.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: Retained Steam pages join media, tags, review context and curation; itch and Modrinth evidence adds independent/experimental games and compatibility-first selection.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: A personalized Discovery Queue was sign-in gated in retained research. A promotional screenshot or a global score is not evidence a Chinese release runs on this player’s machine.

rezics.fit: Shared catalogue, classifications, ratings and release filters are reusable discovery pieces.
rezics.gap: Current sources do not prove sufficient system requirements, accessibility features, controller support, language modalities, media or trustworthy acquisition links on populated game pages.

pass_fail.criterion: For every S-GAME-DECISION candidate, a player can answer language, platform/system requirements, content/version, input/accessibility support, review cohort and acquisition-source questions from sourced facts or explicit unknowns.
Filter results provide matching witnesses and preserve scope through detail/back navigation; metadata-only and media-unavailable cases remain usable without invented facts.
Game and VN cards use truthful domain actions and expose the chosen release; no book-only reading verb or placeholder art is presented as game-specific evidence.

candidate_improvements: Add sourced suitability profiles and domain decisions to the shared release read; qualify one difficult game task against Steam, itch and VNDB rather than copying storefront density.

job_benchmarks.persona: Existing owner buying an edition, DLC or gift
job_benchmarks.task: Compare exact package contents and ownership-sensitive offers before acquisition.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: Steam bundle ownership policies and itch purchase recovery show why a title link and price field do not complete the decision.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: Complete-set gifting is supported in current Steam documentation; assuming an older limitation would mis-benchmark it. A local library entry is not proof of store ownership or refund eligibility.

rezics.fit: Release selection and personal copies can represent part of the catalogue/inventory context.
rezics.gap: Live pricing, regional offers, entitlements, gift rules, payment, refunds and fulfillment are not supplied by cataloguing. Distribution/commerce is closed in the stated launch cut.

pass_fail.criterion: A catalogue comparison lists base/DLC/bundle contents, prerequisites, editions, store/region/time and known policy without treating unverified ownership as eligible entitlement.

Any claimed native checkout/gift/refund completion has an operating authority, entitlement receipt and failure/recovery path; absent those, acquisition is explicitly an external handoff or unsupported capability.
S-GAME-DECISION complete-set/must-purchase-together and recipient-owned cases produce the documented policy distinction, with unknown live price/region facts left unknown.

candidate_improvements: Start with exact offer/content/requirement information and explicit external handoff; seek a separate commercial operating decision before promising native purchase parity.

job_benchmarks.task: Explain why recent, language-specific and overall ratings disagree, then inspect qualified reviews.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: Current Steam scoring and API distinguish population, language, recency, purchase source, free/Early Access context and off-topic activity.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: An individual low-visibility off-topic review can still affect the score, while an excluded off-topic period is different. Helpful-order API pagination is not guaranteed to terminate.

rezics.fit: Contextual question, target, population and rollup machinery is a strong reusable basis.
rezics.gap: The engine does not itself prove purchase verification, anti-manipulation operations, imported-score provenance or clear review-target separation.

pass_fail.criterion: Every displayed aggregate identifies target (story/translation/production or exact game), question/scale, population, count, period, language and provenance; unknown cohort or small sample is explicit.
S-GAME-DECISION cohort changes reproduce the chosen documented inclusion policy; imported aggregate, native rating and individual review are never blended without a declared compatible basis.

Review import/paging has an explicit finite sampling contract or terminating ordering; helpful cursors cannot create an endless supposedly complete import. Negative criticism remains subject to policy-based moderation with reasons.

candidate_improvements: Show cohort/target context beside the number; model imported aggregates as sourced observations and qualify review operations before claiming Steam-level trust.

job_benchmarks.task: Track owned/wanted/playing/completed games separately from licenses, play sessions, saves and achievements.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: A storefront library can connect actual account access, installation and game integrations; native REZICS lists can cover personal organization but not inherit those integrations.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: Being marked owned does not prove access to a store license; a completed play status does not prove achievements or synchronized saves. Cloud is game-integrated, not universal.

rezics.fit: Library/copy/session concepts and private exchange can support tracking across stores.
rezics.gap: No current evidence establishes entitlement reconciliation, launch/install state, game telemetry, achievements, cloud sync or offline client behavior.

pass_fail.criterion: S-LIBRARY game statuses, personal progress, copies and notes remain independent of imported store entitlement and client state; an unavailable integration never clears personal history.
Any offered launch/cloud/achievement action declares the provider, authorization, supported game integration and recoverable unavailable/revoked/conflict outcome; unsupported actions are not enabled.
Tracking-only export preserves user-authored history while naming integration-derived fields and their authority separately.

candidate_improvements: Qualify a cross-store tracking view first; retain client/save/achievement work as explicit integration requirements.

job_benchmarks.persona: Player seeking a fix or contributing a guide
job_benchmarks.task: Find a version-relevant discussion/guide, identify a trusted answer and ask for help with the right context.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: Steam hubs connect guides, reviews, discussions and Workshop; Reddit and Discourse demonstrate scoped thread retrieval and granular participation.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: A guide for a different release or mod loader can worsen the problem. A moderator or developer badge must come from actual authority, not a user-authored label.

rezics.fit: Work-attached discussion, Realm permissions and wiki/evidence owners can share identity and version context.
rezics.gap: Populated help discovery, attachment/version retention, durable answer links and trusted identity need task-level proof; Workshop execution is another capability.

pass_fail.criterion: A query reaches the relevant game/release help thread or guide, preserving scope and version/loader context when opening, replying and returning.
A 500-reply thread supports authorized continuation, comment search, durable reply navigation, accessible sort and edited/deleted-parent states.
Developer/moderator authority and accepted-answer or guide evidence are distinguishable; a reply denied by permission preserves the draft and offers the correct recovery.

candidate_improvements: Attach exact release/compatibility context to help and guides; reuse conversation and knowledge reads rather than create disconnected game forums.

job_benchmarks.persona: Owner needing reliable delivery and offline use
job_benchmarks.task: Recover, download, install, update and run a purchased game under its actual distribution rules.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: GOG is a stronger reference for optional-client offline installers; itch adds account-optional recovery and app delivery; Steam provides integrated client/community capabilities.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: GOG installer availability can lag the published master; itch can offer Install-anyway for incompatible software; Steam offline exceptions are real. No platform wins every job.

rezics.fit: Catalogue release/rights/source metadata can describe requirements and hand off externally.
rezics.gap: Native distribution, accountless purchase recovery, client install/update/rollback, save sync and publisher support are not proved and are explicitly deferred/closed in local launch policy.

pass_fail.criterion: Catalogue claims accurately state DRM/client/offline/platform/license requirements with source/date and unknowns; no assertion of native delivery is inferred from a download URL.

Native delivery parity remains failed/unsupported until an authorized release demonstrates entitled byte integrity, recovery, compatible installation/update/rollback, offline behavior, revocation/refund handling and staffed support.
Any later delivery comparison tests at least a Steam-integrated title, a GOG offline installer and an accountless itch purchase, including the documented adverse states.

candidate_improvements: Maintain a distribution capability ledger and require a finite operating qualification before claiming games beyond catalogue parity.

job_benchmarks.task: Discover the right community, understand participation rules, join or request access, and control following.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: Reddit separates community type, discovery and custom feeds; membership restrictions affect viewing and participation differently.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: Joining many communities does not guarantee all appear in a home visit. Follow, membership and notification subscription are separate intents; a private space must not disclose its concealed content through search.

rezics.fit: Native Realm membership and source-aware follows have defined semantics.
rezics.gap: Current evidence does not prove populated discovery, request/approval recovery, denied-state explanations or quiet attention controls.

pass_fail.criterion: S-COMMUNITY public/restricted/private and pending/approved/revoked cases expose only authorized identity/content and accurately state who may view/post/reply.
Join creates the documented join-derived follow exactly once; leave removes only that source, preserving an explicit/library follow. Notification off remains off.
Community discovery and a saved topic scope have durable navigation, clear rules/language and a useful empty or unavailable state.

candidate_improvements: Qualify the membership/follow/notification state matrix on one populated Realm rather than count Join buttons.

job_benchmarks.task: Read a useful feed, open a long discussion, reply and return without losing place or context.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: Retained Reddit threads and current scoped search establish discussion context; custom feeds support reader-chosen topic streams.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: A feed of Work attachments without post author/title/Realm hides the conversation. An authentication outage silently falling back to anonymous data changes meaning and permission.

rezics.fit: Feed, Realm reply and frontend interaction owners exist.
rezics.gap: Retained audit documented silent anonymous downgrade and stale cursor recovery gaps. Current fixed behavior needs receipts, not an assumption that all audit work has landed.

pass_fail.criterion: Rows distinguish post, author, Realm, Work attachment and time; opening/back navigation preserves scope, scroll/continuation and thread context.
A 500-reply thread preserves parent/child navigation, chosen sort, quote target and draft through failed save, concurrent edit and deleted-parent states; duplicate retry creates one reply.
Signed-in read failure is explicit and retryable; it never silently swaps to an anonymous stream. End, empty, unknown, denied and unavailable are distinct.

candidate_improvements: Prove a long-thread and feed recovery trace with real post/Work distinctions; preserve typed read states through the UI.

job_benchmarks.task: Navigate linked knowledge, compare and restore revisions, and cite the correct historical state.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: Reddit has a substantial wiki/history workflow; Fandom adds category/backlink/maintenance navigation and revision linking.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: Reddit recent changes covers thirty days while per-page history is fuller; old/new wikis may diverge. Fandom oldid can render current dependencies, and hidden revisions remain restricted.

rezics.fit: Exact revision-set and position-aware wiki/evidence reads offer a stronger provenance substrate if implemented throughout the journey.
rezics.gap: Current receipt coverage for durable navigation, compare/restore, moved-page links and authorized historical dependencies is missing. A generated character list is not full wiki parity.

pass_fail.criterion: S-WIKI-HISTORY reaches every authorized page through search/index/backlinks and every selected revision through stable links, retaining moved-title redirects and contributor attribution.
Comparison/restoration names the exact revision set and dependency policy; current restrictions still govern old views, diffs, evidence and exports.

A reader’s position protects hidden facts throughout wiki navigation and history. Missing/erased dependencies are explicit, and no whole-render immutability is claimed without retained dependency bytes.

candidate_improvements: Qualify one moved, heavily revised franchise wiki with evidence and inverse navigation; distinguish semantic pinned history from full host/render migration.

job_benchmarks.task: Contribute, enforce rules, review reports and appeal within precise separate permissions.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: Reddit moderator permissions, Fandom protection and Discourse see/reply/create controls demonstrate distinct authority dimensions.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: A wiki editor need not be a post moderator. A moderator need not see every restricted category. Hiding harmful history must not turn historical citations into a disclosure bypass.

rezics.fit: Realm admin/access and source/contribution lifecycle owners provide reusable permission checks.
rezics.gap: No current observed operating proof covers abuse reports, review queues, sanctions, appeals, transparent reasons and adversarial permission changes.

pass_fail.criterion: The S-COMMUNITY permission matrix enforces see/reply/create/wiki/moderate separately in API and UI, including after revocation and on inverse/history/export reads.

Report, hide/remove, restore and appeal retain actor, reason, scope and audit record; stale decisions refuse with recoverable context. Moderation authority cannot rewrite another author’s source contribution.
Protected or restricted saves explain the allowed next step without losing permitted draft data or exposing concealed facts.

candidate_improvements: Run a least-authority moderation/appeal trace and name the operator responsibilities; avoid granting blanket rights to make fixtures pass.

job_benchmarks.persona: Member returning for a specific answer
job_benchmarks.task: Search across a scoped community/wiki/thread, follow a durable result and receive only chosen notifications.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: Reddit scopes search to communities/custom feeds and comments; Fandom exposes backlinks/categories and page watches.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: A notification is not permission to read its target; access can be revoked after delivery. Rate-limited alerts and empty watch feeds are not proof no event occurred.

rezics.fit: Search, notifications, watches/follows and resource links have native owners.
rezics.gap: Public search coverage, continuation, selected scope, durable reply/history links and budgeted notification reads require fresh verification.

pass_fail.criterion: Community, wiki and within-thread queries return the expected authorized set with active scope visible and preserved through follow-up queries, sort, result and back navigation.
Long and stale cursors recover without dropping scope; a moved/deleted target has an explicit authorized resolution rather than a dead generic route.
Follow/watch/all/highlights/off outcomes deduplicate and respect current permissions. Hidden identity/content never appears in unread counts, notification excerpts or click-through error text.

candidate_improvements: Unify durable resource links and selected scope across search, notifications and history; qualify missed/repeated event and revocation cases.

job_benchmarks.task: Preserve an authorized wiki/community record without pretending a page export recreates the host.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: Fandom documents XML/history export and permission-bound import; its maintenance graph and revision restrictions are part of the job.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: Exported page text/metadata omits independent media hosting, templates/extensions, permissions, identities and routing behavior. Reddit’s non-deletable page policy is not generic physical deletion semantics.

rezics.fit: Native exact observations and revision selections can preserve a bounded accessible semantic cut.
rezics.gap: Full wiki-host migration is deferred; complete community graph/history/media/import compatibility and operator governance are not established.

pass_fail.criterion: An export states selected revision/authority, included pages/relations/supports and unavailable/lost dependencies; it does not leak protected revisions.

A full host-migration claim remains unsupported until route/redirect/backlink, template/media rights, identity/permission, full-history and restore compatibility are actually qualified on a populated archive.

candidate_improvements: Document a bounded semantic export profile; keep host migration as a separately sized operating capability with an explicit loss ledger.

job_benchmarks.task: Disambiguate and maintain series, Work, translation, edition, identifier and format with qualified credits.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: Open Library provides a concrete Work/edition search distinction; calibre handles identifiers, metadata and formats. Provider grains inform but do not override native identity decisions.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: Open Library lang=fr ranks rather than filters. A publisher reprint, ebook file or ordinary translation must not automatically become another creative Work; an ISBN is not a universal Work key.

rezics.fit: The native Work contract explicitly distinguishes realization, independently creative rewrite, publication and personal copy.
rezics.gap: Catalogue profile coverage for anthologies/partial manifestations, translator/illustrator/narrator credit and exact edition discovery remains to qualify.

pass_fail.criterion: Every S-BOOK-EDITION case maps to the adjudicated grain with exact IDs, language/script, contributor roles, publication/date certainty and coverage; no ambiguous-title/ISBN automatic merge.

An edition-language filter restricts the selected edition, while UI locale/ranking preference does not falsely claim a restriction. Translator/narrator inverse results bind the exact realization/recording.
A corrected publication or pseudonym mapping retains original attribution and sources without transferring progress or ownership.

candidate_improvements: Use an adjudicated Book identity table as a source-conformance fixture and expose edition-qualified facts and credits.

job_benchmarks.persona: Reader managing a serious portable library
job_benchmarks.task: Track sessions, rereads, DNF, pauses, exact editions/formats, physical copies and loans, then export them.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: StoryGraph separates private reflection, DNF/ownership and reading history; calibre adds format management. REZICS explicitly intends copies/loans and edition-aware reading.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: Ownership is not completion. An audiobook’s time is not an EPUB chapter location; a reread must not overwrite the first session. Multiple formats in one entry do not prove an identity match.

rezics.fit: Copy/loan modules and snapshot-based private export are real current source affordances.
rezics.gap: Complete personal-field fidelity and resumable populated-library usability across languages/formats are unproved.

pass_fail.criterion: All 1200 S-LIBRARY entries are discoverable across pages, sort and filters; the first view makes current status/session/edition and next action understandable.
Reread, pause, DNF, edition switch, copy loan/return and private note mutate only their own facts; progress re-anchoring is explicit and never inferred from similarity.

A snapshot export and reimport preserve all supported sessions/copies/loans/notes/privacy; mid-export mutation causes explicit restart/conflict and failed import leaves a recoverable unchanged source.

candidate_improvements: Prove one exact personal-library roundtrip and session/copy/loan state matrix; improve the view only where it fails the real job.

job_benchmarks.task: Import and reconcile evidence, correct metadata in bulk and maintain sourced summaries without erasing uncertainty.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: calibre makes bulk metadata and identifier review a real specialist task; Open Library demonstrates identifier-grain lookup and unstable upstream schemas.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: A successful HTTP response with no summary is not evidence that the book lacks one. Blind bulk replacement and mismatched edition metadata can silently corrupt a curated library.

rezics.fit: Exact source retention, mapping/adoption and attribution are reusable foundations.
rezics.gap: Retained Book audit had 119 successful empty summaries and 35 unknown reads in its discovered population. Current correction, coverage, preview and partial-failure recovery need proof.

pass_fail.criterion: Every elected upstream field is classified with exact source revision, target grain and disposition; a failed read stays unknown/unavailable rather than empty.
A bulk change previews exact targets, conflicting independent supports and per-item outcomes; stale or denied items do not silently alter other editions and retry does not duplicate contributions.
Source refresh/withdrawal preserves independently authored metadata and readable history; rights-restricted summaries/media remain unavailable with a truthful reason.

candidate_improvements: Qualify a bounded reconciliation batch with conflicts and partial failure, reusing source decisions rather than inventing a parallel bibliographic authority.

job_benchmarks.task: Choose by mood/content warnings, record a private reaction, then discuss only up to shared progress.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: StoryGraph’s documented discovery and progress-gated buddy reactions address a different need from a public review score. Goodreads retained evidence emphasizes familiar readers’ reviews.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: A warning is a sourced contextual judgment, not a universal fact. Publishing a private journal entry or revealing a reaction title/count early breaks the task even if the main wiki text is hidden.

rezics.fit: Shared classification/Context, reading positions and conversation owners can join discovery, private reflection and evidence.
rezics.gap: Actual buddy-read orchestration, review/journal privacy and warning governance are not proved by a generic discussion tab.

pass_fail.criterion: Mood/warning filters expose chosen Context, source and uncertainty; private notes remain private until an explicit publication action.
At unequal positions, hidden reaction identity/body/count and related wiki evidence do not leak; advancing position reveals only eligible material and never moves another member’s progress.
Readers can distinguish a whole-Work opinion, translation/narration review and chapter reaction, with durable links back to the right target.

candidate_improvements: Test one unequal-progress group with private reactions and scoped reviews; retain unsupported group orchestration as a concrete gap.

job_benchmarks.task: Author/import a structured recipe with exact ingredients, instruction hierarchy, source provenance and controlled export.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: Paprika provides practical authoring/exchange; Cooklang provides a portable procedure format. REZICS’s native exchange specifies richer occurrence/provenance fidelity.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: Parsing is not fidelity: optional sections, repeated ingredients, referenced recipes, media and measures can disappear in interchange. Cooklang implementations differ; REZICS native export is not yet a new-form native import contract.

rezics.fit: Current owners retain exact source text, scalar/range quantities, parse state/spans, ordered structure, Content and explicit export losses.
rezics.gap: End-to-end populated import/edit/export recovery and cross-tool compatibility have not been exercised. A Schema.org file’s importability does not prove lossless native fidelity.

pass_fail.criterion: S-RECIPE import/edit/native export retains exact occurrence identities, order/parentage, text, quantities/units, parse status, Content selectors, measures and independent supports for the selected authorized revision.
Schema.org export lists every unsupported reference/measurement/instruction/derivation loss at a valid native pointer, or explicitly refuses; hidden payloads and identifiers do not leak in sidecars.
Unsupported/hostile input, stale revisions and duplicate retry produce typed outcomes without partial silent publication; no remote fetch is inferred from local file intake.

candidate_improvements: Prove one rich exact-revision export plus a deliberately lossy Schema.org roundtrip; add adapters only with explicit conformance and loss cases.

job_benchmarks.task: Scale servings and units while preserving lexical uncertainty, occurrence-specific substitutions and nutrition basis.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: Paprika demonstrates scaling/unit choices and their parser limits; REZICS contracts distinguish exact amount, wording, scaling policy and measurement coverage.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: Salt-to-taste has no numeric amount to double. Nonlinear ingredients, mass-to-volume conversion and allergen substitution cannot be safely inferred from a string or a generic unit label.

rezics.fit: Recipe and Structure owners encode exact amounts/ranges, scaling policies, substituteFor and measurement basis.
rezics.gap: Retained UI audit found nutrition/substitution retained without a reader at its snapshot. Current populated display/qualifier fidelity remains unproved; professional nutrition/allergen data is a new ecosystem requirement.

pass_fail.criterion: Scaling to 3/18 servings matches exact rational oracle for scalar/range/linear cases; non-linear/not-scalable and unparsed lines remain explicit and original source text is unchanged.
Displayed unit conversion uses only an admitted compatible basis; absent density or unsupported units never produce a guessed mass-volume conversion.

Substitution binds the exact repeated ingredient occurrence; nutrition reports source, per-serving/whole-recipe basis and complete/partial/unknown coverage. Unknown nutrients never become zero or an allergy-safe claim.

candidate_improvements: Expose supported substitutions and measurement provenance/coverage beside ingredients; qualify difficult quantities before adding nutrition or planning promises.

job_benchmarks.persona: Cook with wet hands or assistive technology
job_benchmarks.task: Enter cooking mode, follow ordered steps, check ingredients, run timers and resume after interruption.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: Paprika documents step highlighting, ingredient checkoff, persistent multi-recipe place and timer controls. This is a runtime interaction, not a card-layout comparison.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: Retained CookMode missing-mount behavior belongs to an older revision; current source mounts it. Source presence is still not proof it works with pagination, focus or reload.

rezics.fit: Current RecipeExperience has a CookMode event handler and rendered modal, plus paged recipe readers.
rezics.gap: No current browser/assistive-technology trace proves action feedback, full-step access, timer persistence, focus handling or interruption recovery.

pass_fail.criterion: From a populated Recipe the Cook action opens the real cooking view, ordered sections/steps and all 125 occurrences remain reachable, and failed continuation retains current place and scale with retry.
Checkoff, current step and each timer’s start/pause/cancel state are explicit and do not affect another recipe. Resume behavior across close/reload is specified and verified rather than assumed.
Keyboard and screen-reader use complete the same path with named controls, focus containment/return, visible unobscured focus and status announcements; check applicable WCAG A/AA requirements.

candidate_improvements: Reproduce the old action case on current code and add a populated long-recipe interruption/focus task; preserve a clear unsupported label for persistence not implemented.

job_benchmarks.persona: Household planner or professional prep lead
job_benchmarks.task: Plan multiple recipes, consolidate groceries and pantry stock, and keep scaled quantities and source identity.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: Paprika goes beyond recipe storage with planning, groceries and pantry; Cooklang conventions cover related planning artifacts.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: Two recipes with the same name are not the same recipe; Paprika’s name-link limitation is a useful counterexample. A dinner collection is not a franchise or a functioning stock ledger.

rezics.fit: Native resource IDs, collections and exact quantities can provide reusable linkage and aggregation inputs.
rezics.gap: Complete meal-calendar, pantry/inventory, shopping consolidation, purchasing and collaboration are not evidenced; a generic collection view cannot count as parity.

pass_fail.criterion: A plan links exact recipe revision/serving selections; rename/duplicate titles do not break identity, and a recipe collection is labeled by its actual purpose.
A grocery aggregation preserves chosen scaling, separates incompatible/unknown units and optional/substituted ingredients, and never silently combines uncertain quantities.
Until a real plan-to-grocery-to-pantry trace with edits, stock changes and recovery passes, those capabilities are explicitly unsupported rather than inferred from collections.

candidate_improvements: Keep planning as a finite separate domain qualification; first prove exact recipe references and a bounded honest grocery aggregation if prioritized by synthesis.

job_benchmarks.task: Follow composition, performance/recording, release, medium and repeated track appearances with exact credits.
job_benchmarks.comparator_evidence: MusicBrainz is a stronger specialist reference than VNDB/Steam for musical grain, release media, duplicate checking and sourced editorial review.
job_benchmarks.counterexample_or_limit: The same recording on two tracks is not two compositions; a remaster is not automatically a new performance. MusicBrainz distinguishes expunged from withdrawn and acknowledges multi-CD editing friction.

rezics.fit: Qualified relations and repeated Structure occurrences are reusable; catalog.md explicitly records this remaining grain obligation.
rezics.gap: Retained 49 imported MusicBrainz Works lacked populated native semantic reads at that snapshot. Composition/recording/media/occurrence profiles and specialist UI are not qualified; the current release status enum has no distinct expunged value, so fidelity needs an explicit mapping/gap decision.

pass_fail.criterion: S-MUSIC preserves every elected composition, recording, release, medium and track identity/position with exact source IDs and independent credits; no title-only collapsing or duplicate composition from repeated tracks.

comparison_protocol.input_control: Pin source revisions, native identities, Context/position/authority, locale, selected release and starting state. Prepare one rights-cleared corpus once and restore isolated copies within the existing preparation budget.
comparison_protocol.semantic_gate: Every relevant fixture has an explicit expected answer/witness table. Any contrary result in its specified cases fails a criterion; missing evidence remains unproved. All named positive/negative, paging, privacy, stale and recovery criteria must pass; one forbidden join, fabricated fact, data-loss or disclosure result fails its family.
task_records: Record persona/job, input and initial state, comparator/source revision, result correctness, missing facts, actions/backtracking, elapsed active time, errors, recovery, final state and accessibility blockers.

For a future head-to-head study, perform equivalent real tasks on both products, counterbalance order, and include specialist/returning users. Report raw task counts and sample limitations; do not infer population effectiveness from a small exploratory group.
comparison_protocol.comparative_pass: For common supported jobs, require correct outcomes with zero critical semantic/privacy/data-loss errors, completion at least as high as the comparator and median active task time no greater on the same tested tasks/participants. Report results by job; no weighted overall score can hide a failed core capability. These are proposed thresholds with no current measurements.
comparison_protocol.superiority_rule: Full domain completeness/parity requires the mandatory field/workflow families and all relevant named leader jobs to be supported and task-proved. Any unsupported critical strength blocks that full claim; merely listing it does not pass. For each frozen source record, every supplied field needs a disposition, and excluded/lossy/source-only fields remain gaps when the task needs native behavior. A narrower tested launch win can be reported only for its named task, never as full VNDB/Bangumi/Steam/Reddit/Fandom completeness.
